title: Control Board Communication Fault
shortDescription: Main control and display cannot communicate.
fullDescription:
E01 on Candy dryers indicates a failure in the communication link between the main PCB and the user interface board. Often caused by loose wiring or a failed control board.

Power cycle first. If persistent, reseat the ribbon cable between boards before replacing the PCB.

title: Motor Tacho Fault
fullDescription: E02 indicates the control can't read motor tacho. Broken belt, failed tacho coil, or worn brushes are usual culprits.

title: NTC Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E03 means the NTC thermistor is reporting invalid values. Low-cost sensor swap resolves most cases.

title: Pressure Switch Fault
fullDescription: E04 means the pressure switch reports an invalid state. Check tank and hose first.

title: Drain Pump Fault
fullDescription: E05 indicates pump blocked or failed. Clean filter first.

title: Door Lock Fault
fullDescription: E06 indicates failed door switch or misalignment. Dryer will not start until resolved.

title: Heater Fault
fullDescription: E07 appears when temperature rise is not detected. Usually burnt element or tripped TOC.

title: Heater Relay Stuck
fullDescription: E08 is a safety fault. Unplug immediately; PCB replacement required.

title: Software ROM Error
fullDescription: E09 indicates corrupt firmware. PCB replacement with programmed board usually required.

title: EEPROM Checksum Error
fullDescription: E10 means the EEPROM fails checksum. PCB must be replaced or re-initialised by service.
